tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bka' babs bdun dang ldan pa'i man ngag gi gzhung rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po bde chen rdo rje shrī mād+dhe ru ka zhi ba
༄༅/ /bka' babs bdun dang ldan pa'i man ngag gi gzhung rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po bde chen rdo rje shrī mād+dhe ru ka zhi ba

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bka' babs bdun dang ldan pa'i man ngag gi gzhung rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po bde chen rdo rje shrī mād+dhe ru ka zhi ba sbas pas mdzad pa bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ oṃ badz+ra dhā ra ya na mo/ rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra su mar+g+ga nā maḥ bod skad du/ rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes byung ba/ rdo rje'i 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po bde ba chen po ni/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs 'dud/ /ma lus rgyud rnams thams cad kyi/ /de nyid rab tu gsalabashad bya/ /rgyud kyi dang por e waṃ yig /phung po kun gyi snod yin 'dis/ /stong dang snying rje'i bde chen po/ /sangs rgyas 'dir brjod 'khor ba'ang 'di/ /'on kyang rang bzhin mngon gyur dang*/ /'dzag med sems kyi de nyid rig /'gro la snying rje'i sems chen po/ /rgyud shes slob dpon bsten bya ste/ /bla ma la gus drang po'i dngos/ /lam dang ston pa gzhan spangs pa/ /zab mo'i don la rtog bral bas/ /'bad na thams cad 'bras bur bcas/ /bde ba mchog gi thar pa'i rgyud/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu ni/ /thams cad rang bzhin bde ba che/ /bde bas bde ba che grub pa'o/ /'di la sems kyi rang bzhin gang*/ /sku gnyis por ni rnam par gnas/ /shin tu spros med chos kyi sku/ /gzugs ni lus dang snod bcas pa'o/ /gang la thog ma med pa dang*/ /dang po rgyu med sangs rgyas chos/ /sems can kun la rtag gnas pa/ /rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang bar brjod/ /phung po lnga bdag sangs rgyas dang*/ /rig ma 'byung ba rnams dkyil 'khor/ /dbang po yul dang bcas gang dag/ byang chub sems dpa' lha mor bcas/ /de ltar dri ma rnams sbyangs pa/ /ye shes chen po sgom par bya/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa legs gnas pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dir bsgom byos/ /rten dang brten pa'i rgyu yi phyir/ /lus med pa la bde med pas/ /lus ni dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sems kyang yang dag bde bar 'gyur/ /bsnyen pa nye ba'i bsnyen pa dang*/ /bsnyen pa che dang sgrub par bya/ /bsnyen pa nyer sgrub sgrub pa dang*/ /sgrub pa chen po bsgom bya zhing*/ /rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/

/shin tu yang dag rnal 'byor che/ /sbyor dang dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /phyi nas las rgyal mchog bsgom bya/ /bdag nyid gong bu ltar snang ba/ /rab bkra dbang po'i gzhu ltar snang*/ /phyi nas dngos po kun la spro/ /gcig dang du ma dang bral ba/ /dkyil 'khor dag gi sgo nas byung*/ /zas sogs bya ba thams cad spyad/ /lha yi gsal dang mngon zhen gyis/ /rang gi mi mthun shin tu 'gag /sna rtser yungs kar rnam brtags pa/ /yi ge de bzhin mtshan ma dang/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs dkyil 'khor gyis/ /spros pa'am yang na bsdu bar bya/ /rdo rje'am pad+ma'i sna rtser ni/ /yungs kar tshul gyis mtshan ma bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor spro zhing bsdud pa dang*/ /re re zhing yang rnam par bsgom/ /sku dang bde bar rang bzhin med/ /rnam par rtog las nges byung pa/ /srid pa'i rnam pas de sbyong byed/ /'bras bu'i lam gyur skyes pa'o/ /zhes pa ni rim pa dang po'o/ /sems ni rang bzhin 'od gsal te/ /dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba/ /rang bzhin skye 'gag med pa dang*/ /chos kun mchog tu rgyas btab tshe/ /'dod chags chags bral kun las 'das/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /yod dang med dang yod med 'das/ /rnam par rtog pa'i yul kun spangs/ /tshig dang ming du brjod pa bral/ /bsam gtan rdzun pas ma bslad pa/ /'bad rtsol rgyu dang bral ba yang*/ /bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par 'gyur/ /rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /bden min brdzun min 'di lta bu/ /gang la'ang mi gnas chos kyi sku/ /chos rnams kun tu rnam par snang*/ /sems can khams la rtag gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rang gis rig bya nyid/ /dpe dang rtog pa'i mtshon du med/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs 'pho bas so/ /bde dang sdug bsngal kun las grol/ /rkyen gyis sgyur min rkyen byung min/ /sa dang sa la g.yo med pa/ /rang gis rang nyid shes par bya/ /ji ltar nam mkha' bcos min pa/ /lag sogs mi 'gyur mngon gyur

phyir/ /rang gi sems la yongs tshol ba/ /bla ma dam pa'i rim las rnyed/ /rang bzhin dang ni yid 'gyus kun/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin dbyer med pa/ /'di la rang bzhin spros bral bas/ /g.yo ba dag kyang rnam par dag /mi rtog ma yin rnam rtog min/ /bya ba byed las yongs 'das pa/ /dpyad pa las 'das phyag rgya che/ /ye shes zhabs kyi rim las brnyed/ /rnam par mi rtog mu stegs byed/ / dpyod byed blo ngan sangs rgyas pa/ /rnam pa kun ldan chos gang gi'ang*/ /ma gos mchog tu dben pa'o/ /zhes pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /e waṃ mā yā yi ge mchog /'khor lo bzhi la rnam par gnas/ /sprul pa chos dang longs spyod dang*/ /de bzhin bden chen 'khor lo'o/ /bdun khri nyis stong dang*/ brgya phrag nyi shu lhag pa dang*/ sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ rtsa gsum dang*/ a wa dhū tī dang*/ 'khor lo brgyad dang*/ rtsa'i 'dud pa rnams dang*/ sku'i sgo dgu dang*/ gsung gi sgo bzhi dang*/ thugs kyi sgo gnyis dang*/ srog dang*/ thur sel dang*/ mnyam gnas dang*/ gyen rgyu dang*/ khyab byed dang*/ klu dang*/ rus sbal dang*/ rtsang pa dang*/ lha sbyin dang*/ gzhu las rgyal dang*/ rlung rnams kyi kha dog dang*/ tshad dang*/ grangs dang*/ rgyu ba dang*/ dbyug gu dang*/ chu tshod dang*/ 'pho ba dang*/ thun tshod dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ las dang khams lnga dang*/ drug dang*/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ khu ba dang rdul tha dad dang*/ mnyam par gnas pa dang*/ dbyangs bcu drug 'char ba dang*/ mun pa dang*/ rdul dang*/ snying stobs 'bab pa de dag ni/ e waṃ las byung ba'o/ /nyi ma zla ba nā da gnas/ /bcu gnyis bcu drug de bzhin du/ /bcu gnyis las ni yon tan brgyad/ /phra dang rags pa'i 'khor lo 'khor/ /spyi bor bde ba chen po ste/ /dga' dang tshim dang gnas thod pa/ /'khrig sogs las kyang gsal gyur te/ /de tshe gtso bo khyim bder spyod/ /rnam par dag las bde chen skye/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sku yi rgyal/

/rang bzhin dang ni mas dang yang*/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi gtum mo'o/ /gang du sems spyod der rlung yang*/ /thim 'gyur 'di las mchog gzhan med/ /thig le'i yi ge rtsa la sogs/ /gang bsgom des kyang mchog tu 'gag /gnyis 'gag pa las 'bar ba'am/ /'bar las dbu ma 'byed par 'gyur/ /rtsa gnyis las 'gro 'ong ba dang*/ /'khor lo rnams su 'bar zhing bzlog /thig le'i ye shes 'byung ba ni/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon du 'gyur/ /bum pa can dang rdul mtha' can/ /bgang ba de bzhin rengs byed pa/ /'khor lo rnams su dgag pa dang*/ /sngags dang snying kha de bzhin du/ /rdzas kyang thig le gsum pa ste/ /mi shigs pa dang nor bu dang*/ /'od kyang thig ler mngon brjod pa/ /a ni gtso bo dam pa ste/ /gsal zhing mar me dag dang mtshungs/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu phra ba'o/ /a u mā/ srog dang*/ gyen rgyu dang*/ thig le'o/ /a a hā/ srog dang*/ gyen rgyu dang*/ thur sel lo/ /hā u ma/ thur sel dang*/ srog dang*/ thig le'o/ /yi ge gsum gyi de nyid kyis/ /rlung rnams mchog tu zhi par byed/ /rtags ni lnga las ye shes te/ khams brgyad shin tu rnam dag pa'o/ /zhes pa ni gtum mo'i ye shes so/ /gang phyir dga' ba de snang ba/ /snang ba mched pa mchog dgar bshad/ /dga' bral las ni nyer thob ste/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'od gsal ba'o/ /rig dang 'jug dang skyed pa dang*/ /mtha' las ma nyams gzhan yang 'di/ /yi ge bcu drug dang ni tshes/ /de bzhin dga' ba bcu drug go /'dod pa dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ g.yo ba dang*/ 'dar ba ni dga' ba bzhi'o/ /gang ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ 'char ba dang*/ nub pa ni mchog dga' bzhi'o/ /'bar ba dang*/ khyad par gyi dga' ba dang*/ sems dang*/ thig le ni khyad par gyi dga' ba bzhi'o/ /oṭ+ṭa dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa dang*/ gnyid dang*/ nā da ni/ lhan skyes bzhi'o/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar 'jug par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsum po spangs pa nyid kyi phyir/

/lhan gcig skyes pa byang chub brjod/ /yang na de nyid thams cad bdag /yang na kun gyis rnam par spangs/ /mchog gi mtha' dang dga' bral dbus/ /stong dang stong min he ru ka /pad+ma can dang tshangs ma dang/ /gzhan ni lcug phran ma la sogs/ /bzhin bzang rab tu bzung nas ni/ /mi 'gyur bde ba'i rgyur bsgrub bya/ /yang na yid las byung ba'am/ /mi 'gyur ba ni rdo rje gsor/ /'on kyang mi mo nges par bsgrub/ /gzhan ni mthar thug grub pa med/ /sgron me ldan pas mun pa las/ /nor bu len bzhin phyag rgya las/ /rang bzhin mngon gyur dang po yi/ /las can rnams las gzhan gyis min/ /dbang bskur ba dang sems kyis dgag /dhū tīr 'jug dang bstan pa dang*/ /thim dang ye shes brtan pa dang*/ /spel dang spyod pa'i brtul zhugs dang*/ /skyon sgron ye shes sgom byed pa/ /mngon par byang chub skabs bcu gcig /gzhan ni ye shes sku sgrub pa/ /de dag bzung ma'i byed pa can/ /sna tshogs de bzhin rnam smin dang*/ /rnam nyed dang ni mtshan nyid bral/ /'di shes sgrub la rab 'jug ste/ /blo brtan nus dang bcas pas so/ /sbyor bas lus ni dag byas la/ /steng 'og sbyor bas gcig tu bya/ /sgo dbye btsan thabs sbyor ba ni/ / sngags dang 'khrul 'khor rab sbyor ba'o/ /rjes su chags pas sems dbab ste/ /'di las rang bzhin mtshon bzung nas/ /gyen du skyod dang brtan ldan pas/ /lhan cig skyes pa sgom par bya/ /zhes pa ni/ las kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes so/ /me long gi ni gzugs brnyan gyis/ /sgyu ma'i lus ni mtshon par bya/ kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu/ /khyab pa chu yi zla bas so/ /chos rnams sgyu ma ltar shes nas/ /'di yi rang bzhin bde sgom bya/ /snang ba mtha' dag rnams sprul pa/ /rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku ru brjod/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'o/ /smra dang longs spyod gang gnas pa/ /sems la'ang gzugs brnyan tshul 'char te/ /rmi lam rmi bar yongs ston pa/

/thams cad rlung gi rnam par sprul/ /kun rdzob bden pa sgyu ma nyid/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang de/ /de nyid bar do'i sems can gyur/ /rdo rje sku yang de nyid yin/ /longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'o/ /sgeg dang nye bar longs spyod dang*/ /glu dang rol mo sogs bsten dang*/ /sgyu rtsal rnams la rab 'jug pa/ /chu zla dag dang mtshungs par bya/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa nyid/ /'gro ba sgyu ma ji bzhin bya/ /gang zhig rdo rje sems sogs kyi/ /gzugs brnyan sna tshogs rab bsgyur te/ /gang gang sems kyi yong sprul pas/ /mi skye de las len pa 'gags/ yang na btsan thabs sbyor ba yis/ /tshangs pa'i sgo ni dbye bar bya/ /dpal ldan bde chen mgon po yi/ /zhal gyi rim pa las 'ongs pa'o/ /sprin bral mkha' la mnyam gzhag ste/ /mngon par zhen pa'i lta bas so/ /de las sgyu ma rab grub ste/ /rnam shes gsum po mtshon par bya/ /snang ba dang ni yongs brtags dang*/ /de bzhin rnam par thim pa ni/ /gnyid dang sad dang gnyis gnyis sprod/ /stong pa gsum du rnam par rig /snang dang snang ba mched pa dang*/ /nye bar thob dang 'od gsal ba/ /stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*/ /stong pa che dang thams cad stong*/ /sems dang sems byung ma rig pa/ / gsum las 'das pa mngon par mtshon/ / <gsang 'dus rim lnga'i gzhung drangs pa rang bzhin brgyad bcu'i ngos 'dzin3gt;/ chags bral dang ni bar ma nyid/ / <ni yul la mi sdug par 'dzin pa ngo bo zhing ste de yang 'dzin stangs/> de bzhin du ni chen po dag /yid la 'gro zhing 'ong ba dang*/ / <yul la sems pa dang slar nang du sems pa ste sems pa la phye ba'o//> mya ngan <gi yid du 'ong ba'i yul dang bral ba'i gdung ba ste che bar chung gsum mo/ /> la sogs gsum de bzhin/ / <ba ni ngal zhing thang chad pa ltar had de 'dug pa ste shes bzhin/> zhi dang rnam rtog 'jig pa dang*/ /'jigs pa bar dang shin tu 'jigs/

/sred dang <pa ni yid du 'ong ba dus gsum la dmigs nas zhen pa'o//> sred pa bar ma dang*/ /shin tu sred dang nyer len dang*/ / <len pa sred pa'i yul 'jug par byed pa'i sems so/ > mi dge <pa ni 'gyod pa'o/ /> bkres dang skom nyid dang*/ /tshor dang tshor ba bar ma dang*/ /shin tu tshor ba'i skad cig dang*/ /rig pa po dang rig 'dzin bzhi/ /so sor rtog dang ngo tsha shes/ /snying rje dang ni brtse ba gsum/ / <bde sdug btang snyoms/> dgos dang bsam pa nyid dang ni/ /phrag dog ces ni bya bar bshad/ /dang po'i rang bzhin rnams so/ / <thob bya'i yul la yid/> chags dang zhen <thob zin gyi yul > dang de bzhin dga'/ / < yul yid du 'ong ba snang tsam nas dga' ba ste gsum mo/> dga' ba bar ma shin tu dga'/ /rangs dang <pa ni 'dod don grub pa la dga' ba'o/ /> rab tu mgu ba dang*/ /ngo mtshar <ni gsar thob ro la brten nas sems mtho ba ste ma zhi ba3gt; de bzhin rgod pa dang*/ /tshim pa <ni ngom pa'o/> dang de bzhin 'khyud pa dang*/ /'o byed pa dang < gsum ni de rnams byed par 'dod pa'i sems te yul la chags pas lus ngag gi bya ba rtsom pa dang yang yang de bzhin > 'jib pa dang*/ brtan <pa ni sems mi 'gyur ba ste 'du shes gzhan du rgyur mi thub pa'o/ /> dang rtson dang nga rgyal dang*/ <rtsol ba dang rtsom pa mi 'dor ba'i dpe'o/ /ba ni mtho bar sems pa ste nga rgyal bdun la sogs pa'o/ /> bya dang <pa ni 'du byed kyi don de bya ba rdzogs par byed pa'i rtsol ba mi 'dor ba'o/ /> phrag dog <bar 'dod pa ni brnab sems dang > stobs dang ni/ / spro dang <pa ni las la 'jug pa la yid spro ba'o/ /> lhan cig skyes <tsham tsham > nyid dang*/ / <ni gzhan 'joms par 'dod pa ste gnod sems so/ /> de bzhin gya tshom bar ma dang*/ /gya tshom <ni the tshom ste bya dka' la sbyor ma nus pa'am tshom tshom/> chen po drag po'o/ / <ni khro ba/> rnam par sgeg dang zhe 'gras nyid/

/dge dang <pa'i las la yid rangs pa'o//> tshig gsal <pa ni gzhan gyi go ba 'du shes ma sgyur pa/> bden pa <ra smra ba > dang*/ /mi bden pa <'du shes bsgyur ba ni yi dam brtan por mi 'dod pa'i go cha'o/ /> dang de bzhin nges/ /nye bar mi len <>yul 'dzin par mi 'dod pa/ >sbyin pa po/ / <ra 'dod pa/> skul <yul gzhan du/> dang de bzhin dpa' bo <sgrib pa las grol 'dod do/ /> dang*/ /ngo tsha med <pa ni kha na ma tho ba la mi 'dzem pa'o/ /> dang sgyu dang gdug / <pa lta ngan snga ma ste sbu ba > mi srun pa <gzhan la thos med > dang gya gyu nyid/ / <ni g.yo sgyu gnyis sdom/> gnyis pa'i rang bzhin rnams so/ /chags pa bar ma'i skad cig dang*/ brjed ngas pa dang 'khrul pa dang*/ /mi smrar 'gyur dang skyo ba dang*/ /le lo de bzhin the tshom ste/ /gsum pa'i rang bzhin rnams so/ /rang rig tsam gyi ye shes ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid med/ /'on kyang 'di la dbyer yod de/ /mtshan mo nyin mo mtshams bdag nyid/ /mtshan mo snang ba'i cha ste gsal

<spar ma la tsha > ba nyi ma'i zer 'gyed snang ba mched pa yin/ /mtshams ni snang ba thob pa rang gi rang bzhin rnams kyis lan gcig min par 'gro/ /mtshan min nyin par ma yin mtshams min gang zhig rang bzhin rnams dang rnam bral ba/ /de nyid byang chub skad cig yin par bla ma mchog bshad rnal 'byor pa nyid yul/ /ji ltar sprin ni sna tshogs shing*/ /mdog dang dbyibs ni tha dad pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su byung nas ni/ /de nyid du ni thim par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rang bzhin thams cad ni/ /snang ba gsum gyi rgyu can te/ /ma lus yul la zhugs nas ni/ /'od gsal bar ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /snang ba kun dang bud med sbyor ba dang*/ /'chi ba'i sems dang gnyid la mngon 'jug pa/ /ril por 'dzin dang gzhan gyi rjes su gzhig /rang bzhin gnyis sbyor lam las rtogs par bya/ /rlung rnams phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /shes dang yang dag 'dres gyur nas/ /dbang po'i lam las byung nas ni/ /yul rnams la ni dmigs par byed/ /snying por gyur pa rang srog las/ /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /sgyu ma rlung gi khams gsum po/ /rmi lam rmi ba bzhin du mthong*/ /sa la sogs pa bzhi po dang*/ /de bzhin stong pa bzhi po dag /skye dang 'jig pa'i rgyu nyid du/ /dngos po brgyad po rnam shes bya/ /chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi sku/ /shi dang brgyal dang gnyid dang rmongs/ /bde ba las ni rang rig pa/ /chos kyi sku ru mngon par brjod/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'o/ /zhes pa ni 'od gsal ba'i ye shes so/ /lha dang bla mar bsnyen bya zhing*/ /sgyu ma lta bur rnam bsam mo/ /snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa la/ /bdud kyi 'jigs pa yod ma yin/ /nus bral spyod pa ma 'khrul bas/ /bde dang 'jigs dang yid mi bde/ /gang la'ang sems khral yongs spangs nas/ /ji ltar gdung ba med par spyad*/ /lus ni rgyal ba thams cad dang*/ /de bzhin sems can don sgrub phyir/

/yang na gnod byed rnams la sbyin/ /sems kyi g.yo ba bcad par bya/ /yid ni gzhan du ma gyur par/ /sna tshogs spyod pas rang dang gzhan/ /mnyam pa nyid du rab spyod pa/ /'di la bdud kyi 'jigs pa med/ /lte ba la ni rlung gnas shing*/ /mkhris pa snying dang mgrin pa la/ /dpral ba gtsug tor la bad kan/ /'dus pa gsang ba'i 'khor lo ste/ /de der sbyor bas zhi bar 'gyur/ /grang nad thur sel byed pa can/ /gyen rgyu mnyam gnas skyon tsha ba/ /'khrul 'khor g.yo ba'i rtsa nad 'joms/ /rlung bcu'i skyon yang de der bsal/ /phyin ci log tu rnam sbyar zhing*/ /nam yang byang chub sems 'di bsrung*/ /kha zas spyod lam sbyor ba las/ /de des sems kyi skyon zhi bya/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhal lung ste/ /gzhan las yongs su rtogs ma yin/ /'dus pa dang ni sdom pa dang*/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rjer yang bshad do/ /ye shes ldan pa'ang spyod mi byed*/ /de yis tshe 'dir byang chub med/ /de phyir ye shes bstan gnas pas/ /'dod chags gar gyi rol mo bya/ /dang por mtshan dus gsang de spyad/ /gnyis spangs kun tu spyod pas rgyu/ /gal te dro ba'i bya ba thob/ /rnal 'byor ldan par khas blang ngo*/ /phyi nas 'phags pa'i gnas thob pa/ /des ni phyogs las rnam rgyal bya/ sha za bzhin du kun spyod pa'am/ /yang na khyim du zlos gar bya/ /rim pa dang por rig 'dzin dang*/ /'dod dang gzugs khams lhar sgrub pa/ /ye shes sku dang mngon byang chub/ /sa dang sa la mngon bsgrod pa/ /de bzhin mngon par byang chub che/ /spyod pa'i dus ni rnam pa lnga/ /bskyed rim bde ba bcas bsgom na/ /dran pa nyer bzhag rnam bzhi'o/ /yang dag spong dang rdzu 'phrul rkang*/ /dbang po stobs rnams spyod bcas pa/ /bde chen byang chub yan lag bdun/ /sa dang sa la yan lag brgyad/ /'on kyang 'di la dbyer yod de/ /rtsa rnams las ni sa bcu dang*/ /rlung gi bsgrod bcas de bzhin bcu/

/gzhan ni ye shes sa bcu ste/ /rtsa sogs ye shes lus thim pa'o/ /bcu gnyis sa yi dbang phyug ni/ /bde mchog bde chen rdo rje 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma rgyud las/ /man ngag rab tu bsdus pa'o/ /dpal ldan bde chen las 'ongs pa/ /mi shes 'jig rten rmongs rnams la/ /sems ni snying rje'i dbang gyur pas/ /bde chen rdo rje bdag gis bshad/ ces pa ni rdo rje'i lam bzang po gsal bar byed pa/ slob dpon chen po bde ba chen po'i rdo rje'i zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan he ru kar mngon par dbang bskur ba/ brtul zhugs spyod pa zhi ba sbas pas mdzad pa'o/ /mchog tu rgya che'i gzhung lugs las/ dī na ka ras rnams bsdus pa/ /ye shes mchog gis mchod byas te/ /'gro la phan pa bskyed phyir byas/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po bud+dha gubha'i zhal snga nas dang*/ nirbā ṇa shrī'i zhabs la/ rmongs pa tā ra nā thas zhus te gus pa chen pos 'bad pas bsgyur ba'o/ /rim lnga dang kyai rdo rje'i lung grangs pa sogs ni 'gyur rnying ji lta ba bzhin du bris pa'o/ /slob dpon chen po zhi ba sbas pas nang gi khyab pa zhes bya ba tshigs bcad nyis brgya pa dang*/ rtsa'i mdo la phyed dang nyis brgya/ rlung gi mdo la phyed dang nyis brgya/ khams kyi mdo brgya phrag gcig lam lnga bstan pa la £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ lung 'dren mi the ba tshig gsar £© nyis brgya/ rgyu bstan pa la brgya/ gnas bstan pa la nyis brgya/ phyag rgya chen lam rdzogs pa dang*/ gtum mo'i gzhung la brgya nyi shu/ des lam rdzogs pa dang*/ lhan skyes gsal ba zhes pa la brgya bdun cu/ phyag rgyas lam rdzogs pa dang*/ ye shes nges bstan la sum brgya/ sgyu lus dang 'od gsal rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ man ngag thor bu la lnga brgya/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang kyai rdo rje dang bde mchog rnams la bsdus pa'i don gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ rdo rje'i glu dang sgrub thabs chung ngu yang mang du mdzad par gda' la rgyas pa la dga' ba'i dbang du byas pa dang*/

'bring du dga' ba la/ de dag las bsdus te rdo rje lam che ba tshigs bcad stong tsam yod pa rnal 'byor ma dī na ka ra la sogs pa/ slob ma mchog mang pos spyan sngar bsdus so/ /bsdus pa la dga' ba la lam bar ba tshigs bcad sum brgya pa slob dpon su mā tis bsdus so/ /shin tu bsdus pa la dga' ba'i don du £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ lam ）gzhung chung ba 'di la rgya gar skad du tshigs bcad brgya dang lnga yod pa 'di yin te/ bod skad du'ang rags rtsis la tshigs bcad de tsam ste rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ dā+-i ni ka ras zhus nas bsdus pa 'di ni shin tu dar ba yin par gda' 'o/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas reg zig go/ //dge'o// //maṅgalaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bka' babs bdun dang ldan pa'i man ngag gi gzhung rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 228 -- PAGE 229 -- PAGE 217 -
